Name: WU-Dwarf dialogue expansion and portrait-The Last Smoluanu--Fantasy Series
Author: xiaowugogo
Description:
该mod，将会在我新mod发布的时候永久隐藏

原作者冰淼，mod尾号14347
原现代的肖像行走图和此现代的通用


作者说可二转二改,就改了行走图和肖像,统一了mod数据,改了一点代码错误
如有侵权,请作者私聊我,我会下架AND~非常感谢Crezia做的英文翻译！

本mod，需要搭配Portraiture
在mods\Portraiture\Portraits里新建英文或者数字名的文件夹，然后把Dwarf头像放入，游戏内按p查看，o是锁定（如果你没改快捷键的话）
--------------------------------------------------
理论上兼容The Last Smoluanu - A Dwarf Expansion.
下载可选文件
把Dwarf和DwarfKrobusFlying，放到
[CP] Dwarf Expansion\assets\sprites 进行替换即可


-------机翻
This mod will be permanently hidden when my new mod is released

Original author Bing Miao, mod ending in 14347
The original modern portrait walking diagram and this modern universal
Thank you very much for Crezia's English translation!

The author said it could be converted and modified twice, so they changed the walking image and portrait, unified the mod data, and made some code errors
If there is any infringement, please message me privately and I will take it down。

There are two versions of walking charts in assets that need to be changed by swapping their names
This mod needs to be paired with a portrait

Create a new folder with an English or numeric name in mods \ Portrait \ Portraits, then put the Dwarf avatar in it. Press' p 'to view it in the game, and' o 'to lock it (if you haven't changed the shortcut key)

Theoretically compatible with The Last Smoluanu - A Dwarf Expansion
Download optional files
Put Dwarf and DwarfKrobusFlying in
[CP] Dwarf Expansion \ assets \ sprites

Downloads.Description:
为了兼容The Last Smoluanu.只需要替换两个图即可（如果有bug请告诉我）

安装方式：把行走图Dwarf和DwarfKrobusFlying，放到

[CP] Dwarf Expansion\assets\sprites 进行替换
非常感谢Crezia的英文翻译！Thank you very much, Crezia, for translating mod in English!
